raw.details:
Innovate. Build. Disrupt.:

  • SINGULARITY is a premier inter-college hybrid hackathon organized by BLITZ, the Computer Science Society of Keshav Mahavidyalaya, University of Delhi. Built for visionary thinkers, coders, and creators, this challenge invites students from colleges across India to collaborate, build, and pitch disruptive, real-world solutions across cutting-edge technology sectors.
  • Registration Fee: 100 Rupee per member of the team
  • For Payment check the SINGULARITY RULEBOOK, fill out the Google Form attached at the end of the ruleboook.

Round 1: Online Evaluation:

  • Teams must formulate their ideas and submit a conceptual presentation (PPT) detailing their proposed solution and implementation framework. A specialized faculty panel will evaluate the submissions and shortlist the most promising teams for the grand finale.

Round 2: Grand Finale — On-Site Hackathon:

  • The top 10 shortlisted teams will earn their spot in the Reading Room at Keshav Mahavidyalaya for an intense, single-day, in-person hacking and pitching experience. Teams will work on their solutions, demonstrate their innovations, and present their projects to the judging panel.
  • Bring your laptops, choose your track, and prepare to design the technology of tomorrow!

Themes & Focus Areas:

  • Select one of the following seven tracks for your project:

Cybersecurity:

  • Protecting networks, ensuring data integrity, and securing digital infrastructure.

FinTech:

  • Engineering disruptive digital banking, payment solutions, and wealth-tech platforms.

Healthcare:

  • Empowering medicine, diagnostics, and patient care through technology.

Robotics, IoT & Automation:

  • Designing smart hardware, connected devices, and intelligent automated workflows.

Web3:

  • Building decentralized architectures, smart contracts, and blockchain-powered innovations.

AR/VR & Immersive Experiences:

  • Architecting virtual spaces and developing next-generation spatial computing interfaces.

Open Innovation:

  • Bring your own unique problem statement and develop a creative, technology-driven solution.

Important Timelines:

  • Registration Opens: 2 November 2026
  • Registration & PPT Submission Deadline: 10 November 2026
  • Round 1 Results: 13 November 2026
  • Final Offline Hackathon: 17 November 2026 | 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM
  • Important: Ensure that your team completes registration and submits its PPT before the deadline to be considered for the first round.

Prizes & Rewards:

  • First Place: ₹5,000 Cash Prize + Goodies
  • Second Place: ₹3,000 Cash Prize + Goodies
  • Third Place: ₹2,000 Cash Prize + Goodies

Perks For All Participants:

  • All participants can look forward to event-branded goodies during the offline phase.

Ready To Make Your Mark?:

  • Bring your ideas to life, collaborate with brilliant minds, and compete to create solutions that matter.
  • SINGULARITY 2026 — Where Ideas Converge and Innovation Begins.

Organized By BLITZ | Computer Science Society | Keshav Mahavidyalaya, University Of Delhi
